current_prompt.body: IDENTIFY at least seven missing security or functional requirements in the authentication system specification. INCLUDE requirements related to password handling, credential storage, token security, session management, admin capabilities, audit logging, and user privacy. CONSIDER aspects such as password strength rules, hashing algorithms, token expiration and revocation, secure transmission, role-based access controls, logging of administrative actions, and mechanisms for users to manage their credentials. DO NOT PROVIDE the actual analysis or solutions; ONLY LIST the required missing requirements as the operative task description.

current_plan.body:
IDENTIFY the authentication system specification document
EXTRACT all currently stated security and functional requirements from the specification
DEFINE the set of required requirement categories: password handling, credential storage, token security, session management, admin capabilities, audit logging, user privacy
FOR EACH category, COMPARE the extracted requirements against the expected controls (e.g., password strength rules, hashing algorithms, token expiration and revocation, secure transmission, role‑based access controls, logging of administrative actions, mechanisms for users to manage credentials)
ISOLATE categories where expected controls are absent or insufficient
COMPILE a list of at least seven missing requirements representing the gaps identified across the categories
EMIT the compiled list as the operative task description
